cues: Unless means if not: you will fail unless you work hard.
Provided that, and as long as, set one condition.
In case is a precaution, not the same as if: take an umbrella in case it rains.
Even if: the result holds anyway.
But for, plus a noun, means if it had not been for: but for your help, I would have failed.
And otherwise: hurry, otherwise you will be late.
